handoff.finding: parent_messages lacks canonical lesson-plan delivery identity and idempotent mutation authority
handoff.objective: Make parent lesson delivery traceable to one lesson plan and safe to repeat without producing duplicate messages.
required_contracts: parent_messages must carry lesson_plan_id referencing lesson_plans(id)
one lesson-plan delivery per student and delivery purpose must be enforced by a database uniqueness contract
delivery mutation must be authorized against the authenticated lesson-plan teacher or school administrator
repeating the same delivery request must preserve or update the canonical row instead of inserting a duplicate
LessonPlanModal must consume one shared parent-delivery service instead of inserting parent_messages directly
lesson plan status must change only after parent delivery and derived-asset operations return successful outcomes
safety_constraints: Do not delete existing parent messages.
Do not rewrite unrelated communication or VibeConnect architecture.
Do not send duplicate learner or parent notifications.
Do not use service-role credentials in client code.
Do not make parent delivery dependent on AI availability.
Do not combine this fix with LP-002A2C UI/action separation.
Migration must be additive, reversible where practical, and fail closed.
expected_scope: generated database types updated after schema confirmation
registry and handover updates only after implementation verification
handoff.next_action: Audit the live parent_messages table and policies, then implement the smallest guarded migration and shared service that establish canonical lesson-plan delivery identity and idempotency.

fixes.title: Separate publish, parent delivery and derived asset actions
Structured fix registry and automatic selection
